added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
Director of Engineering - Product

Fully Remote - US

Base $210k - $240k + Competitive Equity

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a Series A EdTech startup backed by mission-aligned investors. The platform has strong commercial traction across multiple US states with strong NRR and a deeply mission-driven team with deep roots in the industry they serve. Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months.

They’re hiring a Director of Engineering - Product to report directly to the CTO and co-founder, taking ownership of multiple product squads. 50/50 hands-on IC and leadership to start, shifting to 80/20 over time. Real ownership of architecture decisions, squad delivery, and cross-functional alignment across a mission-driven team.

Responsibilities

Own multiple product squads - managing engineers and driving delivery across all of them
Hands-on early - contributing code, code reviews, and pairing (~50/50 IC to leadership, shifting to 80/20 over time)
Make and land key technical architecture decisions to ensure the platform scales for the next two years of growth
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and cross-functional stakeholders to align engineering priorities to business outcomes
Ship high-value product features on time, including advancing AI-powered capabilities

Requirements

2-3+ years managing multiple engineering teams (6+ engineers) - ideally including managing other managers
Hands-on technical ability - reads, reviews, and writes code; not a pure people manager
Strong backend architecture experience - able to ramp on new stacks (React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB)
Experience owning major business verticals, products, and business outcomes (speed, quality, growth, retention)
Startup or high-growth environment experience - comfortable with ambiguity and independent prioritisation
Strong communicator - connects technical decisions to business outcomes and drives cross-functional alignment
Mission-driven - genuine passion for the education space
Able to travel for company retreats twice a year plus 2-4 additional business trips
No new visa sponsorship required - transfers considered

Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB

Series A, strong commercial traction, strong NRR, and Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months. Full benefits including health, parental leave, 401(k), unlimited PTO, and coworking access. If you’re a hands-on engineering leader who wants real ownership at a mission-driven startup with genuine product-market fit, we’d love to hear from you.

added.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Beverage Carton
added.description:
Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Operating Unit Engineering – Beverage is responsible for providing technical leadership and engineering support across multiple gable-top carton manufacturing facilities. This role drives safety, quality, operational performance, equipment reliability, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the operating unit. The position serves as the technical authority for Lithographic Offset Printing, Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, rotary and flatbed score-and-cut tooling, and water-based, UV, and Electron Beam (EB) ink technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Lead engineering activities across beverage carton manufacturing operations; drive safety, quality, throughput, yield, uptime, and scrap reduction initiatives; provide technical leadership to plant engineering and operations teams; support capital projects, equipment commissioning, and process optimization efforts.

Specialized Technical Leadership

Provide subject matter expertise in Lithographic Offset Printing, Conventional Flexographic Printing, HD Flexographic Printing, Rotary Die Cutting and Scoring, Flatbed Die Cutting and Scoring Tooling, Gable-Top Carton Converting, Water-Based Ink Systems, UV Ink Systems, EB Ink and Coating Systems, and Color Management Processes.

Process Engineering Responsibilities

Optimize print quality, color consistency, registration control, tooling performance, carton dimensional accuracy, coating performance, and manufacturing efficiency. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for process defects and quality issues.

Manufacturing Excellence

Drive OEE improvement, downtime reduction, yield improvement, scrap reduction, changeover optimization, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.

Capital Projects & Commercialization

Develop scopes of work, equipment specifications, business cases, and implementation plans. Support FAT/SAT activities, commissioning, startup, and commercialization of new products and technologies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline. Minimum 10 years of manufacturing engineering experience with at least 5 years supporting carton converting, packaging, printing, or paperboard manufacturing operations. Experience with gable-top beverage packaging preferred.

Travel

Up to 75% travel to manufacturing facilities, suppliers, and customer locations as required.

Success Metrics

Safety performance, print quality, OEE improvement, scrap reduction, downtime reduction, capital project execution, tooling optimization, and successful implementation of engineering standards across manufacturing sites.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000-$165,000 + bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Novolex, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

The benefits for this role include 401(k) plan with company match, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending and health savings accounts, paid vacation, and sick days, paid parental leave, paid holidays and wellness program.

Company Benefits

What You'll Get From Us
Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com .
